title: DOG SHELTER SUPPORT
summary: RCBC is delighted to share that our large-scale Dog Shelter Support Projects has begun this auspicious festive season.
description:
RCBC is delighted to share that our large-scale Dog Shelter Support Projects has begun this auspicious festive season.

Shweta Rao’s dog shelter in Badlapur was given the medical equipment committed by the Rotary Club of Bombay Central, which was generously donated single-handedly by Dr. Jheel Vasani, daughter of member Rtn Professor Dr. Sunil and R/Ann Arti Vasani.

Food and medicines from RCBC will also be given shortly.
